## Microsoft FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长计算

**原始数字（来自 press_release.txt 和 metrics.txt）：**
- FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日三个月）：**$39,306 百万**
- FY25 Q4（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日三个月）：**$29,878 百万**

**计算过程：**
同比增长率 = ($39,306 - $29,878) / $29,878 = $9,428 / $29,878 = **31.55%**

微软官方披露为 **32%（GAAP）**，**31%（恒定汇率）**（press_release.txt："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"；metrics.txt 显示 32% / 31%）。差异来自四舍五入。

---

### 2. 管理层归因（引自 transcript.txt）

Amy Hood 在电话会上是这样说的（transcript.txt 第 ~24700 字符段）：

> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

此外，本地服务器业务方面：

> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."

---

### 3. 已发生事实 vs 前瞻性表述

| # | 归因表述 | 性质 | 依据 |
|---|---------|------|------|
| 1 | Azure 收入增长 43% | **已发生** | 描述的是刚结束的 FY26 Q4 实际业绩（"revenue grew 43%"） |
| 2 | 客户需求持续超过可用产能 | **已发生（持续状态）** | 描述当前产能状况（"continues to exceed"），是对现状的陈述 |
| 3 | CPU/GPU 车队效率提升 | **已发生** | 解释本季度增长为何超预期（"driven by efficiency gains"） |
| 4 | 流程改进使新产能更早交付 | **已发生** | 同样是已实现的运营改善（"process improvements to enable earlier delivery"） |
| 5 | 额外产能被快速变现 | **已发生** | 描述本季度已发生的商业结果（"was quickly monetized"） |
| 6 | GitHub Copilot 6 月商业模式变更后消耗超预期 | **已发生** | 变更发生在 6 月（本季度内），结果是已实现的（"Results also benefited from"） |
| 7 | "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply"（Q1 指引段） | **前瞻性** | 出现在展望部分（transcript.txt 第 ~32535 字符），描述未来持续关注的方向 |
| 8 | "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | **前瞻性** | 明确使用"continue to expect"，是对未来半年增长加速的指引 |
| 9 | Q1 FY27 Intelligent Cloud 收入指引 $40.95–$41.25B（增长 33%–34%） | **前瞻性** | 明确的未来季度财务指引 |
| 10 | Azure Q1 增长预计约 45%（恒定汇率） | **前瞻性** | 未来季度的增长预测 |

**区分方法说明：**
- **已发生事实**：使用过去时态动词（grew, benefited, was monetized）或描述已完成的动作，对应 FY26 Q4 已结束期间的业绩。
- **前瞻性表述**：使用"expect"、"continue to expect"、"we remain focused"等措辞，或给出明确的未来数字指引，出现在 transcript 的 outlook 部分（位置 ~32400 之后），并受 forward-looking statements 免责声明覆盖。
- **"需求超过供给"**本身是跨期陈述：在 Q4 回顾段描述当前状态（已发生），在展望段再次出现则作为未来策略背景（前瞻性），需结合上下文判断。
